question: Which among the following is the primary constituent of pearls?
solution:
The correct answer is** __Calcium carbonate.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Pearl is a hard object produced within the soft tissue of the living shell mollusk or other animal such as **Fossil Conlariids.**
 
• Pearls are made of** calcium carbonate and contains only carbonates,** so they can dissolve in vinegar.
 
• **Calcium carbonate is **a chemical compound,** and also** a dietary supplement.
 
• The body need calcium to **maintain healthy bones, muscles, neurological system, and heart.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **CaSO4 (calcium sulphate)** is a naturally occurring calcium salt. It is most well recognised in its dihydrate form it is a**s gypsum, a white or colourless powder. **
 
• **Magnesium peroxide** is a stable oxygen-releasing chemical that is employed in agriculture and the environment. Magnesium peroxide can enhance soil quality for plant development and metabolism when employed in bioremediation of polluted soil.
 
• **Sodium bicarbonate,** commonly known as baking soda or bicarbonate of soda,** is a chemical compound with the formula NaHCO₃**
